page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a 2.0 GB per core memory-to-vCPU ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with the stress-ng multi-core CPU test and PassMark CPU score both placing in the top 25%. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 294.35 GB/sec, and PassMark database operations score 25541.61, also in the top 25% tier. Conversely, single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression falling into the middle 50% average category. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance, with read-only large block speeds at 168.6 GB/sec and write speeds at 68.03 GB/sec.

The instance offers a high density of physical compute cores relative to memory, making it a cost-efficient option for parallel processing workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPUs represents a tradeoff, limiting its utility for large-scale local database caching or heavy deep learning training. It is suited for multi-threaded CPU tasks, cryptography supported by hardware-accelerated AES and VAES flags, medium-scale LLM inference, and high-throughput web serving.
